name: deadlock
aspect_notes: Approximate 16:9 search regions, not pixel-exact UI contracts. Native 16:10/ultrawide retains height-relative HUD size with left/right/center anchors; stretched or customized HUDs need calibration. For pillarbox/letterbox footage use pixels(..., letterboxed=True) or crop to the content first. UI scale, patches and spectator overlays can shift regions.
alive_rules: Third-person hero control, positive health, active abilities and reticle support alive state.
dead_rules: Bottom-center Respawn in banner with Shop & Upgrade; right-side INCOMING DAMAGE (LAST DEATH) or Killing Blow; grayscale plus respawn evidence.
spectating_rules: Camera following another hero after death; the grayed ability bar may remain visible.
highlights: Confirmed multikills, soul-denial outplays, urn delivery/steals, and decisive Patron or guardian fights.
lowlights: Lost urn, overextension, failed ability combo, or avoidable death losing souls/objectives.
